briefing.headline: OpenAI and Google race to deploy next-gen agentic systems amid rising compute shortages

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race has intensified with multiple frontier labs releasing advanced reasoning models this month. Funding continues at record pace while safety concerns mount over agentic capabilities. Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with multi-agent orchestration, Anthropic launched Claude 4 Opus, and DeepSeek unveiled R2. Google DeepMind's Gemini 3 shows strong gains in long-context reasoning. Meta open-sourced Llama 4 405B under new licensing.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: New vulnerabilities reported in multi-agent frameworks. Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA announced Blackwell Ultra shipments ramping to 2M units quarterly. Microsoft and xAI both broke ground on new 100k H100-equivalent clusters. Power grid constraints now limit further expansion in Texas and Arizona.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will regulatory intervention slow US labs enough for Chinese competitors to close the frontier gap by 2028?
